=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:604 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `try/except CommandFailure: return True` in `_validation_assets_tracked` is too narrow, so other exceptions (e.g. `FileNotFoundError`, `OSError`) from `executor.run` would propagate to `process_repository` and fail the consumer with `outcome="error"`.
  WHY: Reviewer rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes this: it says `CommandExecutor.run` (scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:198-213) converts `TimeoutExpired` and `FileNotFoundError` into `CommandFailure`, so the finding is a false positive.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:529 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Self-test runs per consumer are synchronous, so consumers that hit the full 900s timeout block the remaining work.
  WHY: Several 900s timeouts can reach the 60-minute CI job cap and cause later consumers to be skipped. Reviewer rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes the editor ignored this with a documented reason.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:535 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `CommandFailure` handler passes `timeout_secs=self_test_timeout_secs` to `_format_command_failure`.
  WHY: The reviewer concluded `_format_command_failure` (line 1438) only adds `timeout_secs` when `returncode == 124`, so the behavior is correct. Rated NIT.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:599-617 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `git ls-files -- validation` call in `_validation_assets_tracked` inherits the executor's default 300s timeout, so a hung git would stall each dirty consumer for 5 minutes.
  WHY: This is a hardening suggestion (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1): pass `timeout=30` to the call. The existing `except CommandFailure` path already handles the raise.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
